+"""Tests for the WebKit view background stylesheet."""
+
+import pytest
+
+QWebView = pytest.importorskip('PyQt5.QtWebKitWidgets').QWebView
+
+from qutebrowser.browser.webkit import webview
+
+
+def test_webview_background_stylesheet_uses_configured_alpha(qtbot,
+                                                              config_stub):
+    """Apply a configured translucent webpage background in QSS."""
+    view = QWebView()
+    qtbot.addWidget(view)
+    view.STYLESHEET = webview.WebView.STYLESHEET
+    config_stub.val.colors.webpage.bg = 'rgba(12, 34, 56, 78)'
+
+    webview.WebView._set_bg_color(view)
+
+    assert 'background-color: rgba(12, 34, 56, 78)' in view.styleSheet()
